title: UI Logic and Hooks
summary: This module provides a collection of React hooks and context definitions that encapsulate complex UI logic, state management, and interactions with chat and model-related functionalities. It handles streaming updates, chat lifecycle operations, model capabilities, and UI autoscrolling.

nodes.label: Manage Streaming State
nodes.title: StreamingContextType
nodes.description: Defines the structure for managing real-time streaming state, including active chat IDs, loading statuses, abort controllers, and download progress.

nodes.label: Determine Chat Load Status
nodes.title: useIsWaitingForLoad Hook
nodes.description: Hook to check if a chat is waiting for its initial content load, considering streaming and recent activity to refine UI feedback.

nodes.label: Dismiss Stale Model
nodes.title: useDismissStaleModel Hook
nodes.description: Provides a function to mark a model as dismissed, preventing repeated stale warnings and triggering model list updates.

nodes.label: Check Stale Model Display
nodes.title: useShouldShowStaleDisplay Hook
nodes.description: Determines if a warning for a stale model should be shown, based on model status, user dismissals, and cloud settings.

nodes.label: Track Download Progress
nodes.title: useDownloadProgress Hook
nodes.description: Retrieves the current download progress for a specific chat from the streaming context.

nodes.label: Cancel Message Generation
nodes.title: useCancelMessage Hook
nodes.description: Provides a function to abort an ongoing message generation or model download, clearing associated UI states.

nodes.label: Delete Chat
nodes.title: useDeleteChat Hook
nodes.description: Handles the deletion of a chat, updating the UI and navigating away if the deleted chat was active.

nodes.label: Manage Chat Autoscroll
nodes.title: useMessageAutoscroll Hook
nodes.description: Controls automatic scrolling behavior in chat interfaces, adjusting view based on new messages, streaming, and user interaction.

nodes.label: Check Vision Capability
nodes.title: useHasVisionCapability Hook
nodes.description: Determines if a given model supports vision-related functionalities.

nodes.label: Check Tools Capability
nodes.title: useHasToolsCapability Hook
nodes.description: Determines if a given model supports tool-use functionalities.

nodes.label: Batch Query Updates
nodes.title: useQueryBatcher Hook
nodes.description: Batches multiple updates to a React Query cache key, optimizing performance by reducing frequent re-renders.

nodes.label: Rename Chat
nodes.title: useRenameChat Hook
nodes.description: Handles renaming a chat, updating the backend and invalidating UI caches to reflect the change.

nodes.label: API Client
nodes.title: api_client module
nodes.description: Handles all communication with the backend API for data fetching and mutations, including chat, model, and settings operations.

nodes.label: Data Models & Routing
nodes.title: data_models_and_routing module
nodes.description: Provides data structures (e.g., Chat, Model) and handles UI navigation logic within the application.

nodes.label: React Query
nodes.title: React Query Library
nodes.description: A library for data fetching, caching, synchronization, and state management in React applications.

nodes.label: Browser APIs
nodes.title: Browser APIs
nodes.description: Standard browser functionalities like timers (setTimeout), DOM manipulation, and event observers (ResizeObserver, MutationObserver).

nodes.label: React Core
nodes.title: React Core Hooks
nodes.description: Fundamental React hooks (e.g., useRef, useState, useEffect) and context mechanisms for component logic.

groups.label: UI State & Context
groups.title: Manages Global UI State and Context
groups.description: This group defines and manages global UI state, particularly for real-time streaming and optimized React Query updates.

groups.label: Chat Management Hooks
groups.title: Handles Chat Lifecycle and Content Operations
groups.description: This group provides hooks for managing the lifecycle of chats, including deletion, renaming, message cancellation, and UI scrolling behavior.

groups.label: Model Status & Capabilities Hooks
groups.title: Provides Logic for Model-Specific Features
groups.description: This group contains hooks that analyze and provide information about model status, capabilities, and related UI display logic, such as stale model warnings and download progress.
